name: Benewake TFmini-S
description: Single-point 850 nm VCSEL time-of-flight distance sensor, 0.1–12 m at up to 1000 Hz, UART/I²C.

specs.label: Interface
specs.value: UART (115200 default) / I²C (addr 0x10, 400 kbps) / I/O; LVTTL 3.3 V; 10 cm cable

specs.label: Power
specs.value: 5 V ±0.1 V, ≤140 mA avg (200 mA peak), ≤0.7 W

specs.label: Weight
specs.value: 5 ±0.3 g; PC/ABS housing; no ingress rating

envelope.axes: x = length across mounting ears, y = height of front face, z = depth along the optical axis incl. lens bosses

features.label: Mounting holes
features.value: 2× Ø2.35 through holes in end ears, 36 mm centre-to-centre, on the horizontal centre line; body between ears 33 mm long.

features.label: Lenses
features.value: Ø9.4 and Ø10.4 lenses, centres 10 mm apart (19.9 mm outer span), on the centre line 7.5 mm from the edge (mid-height of 15).

features.label: Depth steps
features.value: Ear tabs 5 mm from the back face, body 11 mm, overall 16 mm incl. lens bosses; 92° clearance angles drawn above the lens bosses.

amazon.title: Benewake TFmini-S Lidar Sensor Range Finder Module 5V UART I2C 0.1m-12m

notes: ASIN B07B631YRF dates from 2018 (original TFmini era) but the current title is TFmini-S; alternative listings: B08D1XVRV5 (Stemedu), B0FSCZY5PM (Dxtvate). Seller not confirmed (page truncated). Which lens is emitter vs receiver is not labelled on the drawing.
